# What should you charge to clean this array?

> Free solar panel cleaning quote calculator. Enter your rate, speed per panel and costs; get a price per job and per panel at your target margin, a day route pack, and a payback check for the homeowner. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
